column1: # 🔵 The two models are not better and worse; they are OPPOSITE. Open edX's facade can narrow
# a key and cannot tell you who acted. Chamilo enforces real role checks in code at 48 sites
# and cannot narrow a key BELOW the user — the key IS the user — and also cannot tell you who
